summary.root_cause_text: Ops config change set payment_provider_url to internal://payments-v2 (provider migration), which is unreachable, so payments failed silently (DEBUG only) and orders were marked processed without payment. Worker went into a stuck wait state (heartbeat stale), so the queue backed up (depth 42).
recommended: Confirm payments-v2 endpoint readiness before retrying the migration
Alert on payment provider failures logged at DEBUG and on worker stalls

events.text:
version: v1.3
payment_provider_url: internal://payments-v2
queue_max: 1000
worker_count: 1
sync_interval_s: 5
Provider URL change matches. Revert it to v1.
payment_provider_url: 'internal://payments-v2' -> 'internal://payments-v1'. Confirmed: the service is now using the new value.
Worker is stuck (heartbeat 10s, queue growing). Config is now correct, so restart is safe.
All business invariants green (health, payments, queue, worker, ledger, errors, latency).

root_causes: Ops config change set payment_provider_url to internal://payments-v2 (provider migration), which is unreachable, so payments failed silently (DEBUG only) and orders were marked processed without payment.

args.summary: The ops change to payments-v2 made the payment provider unreachable. Orders were marked processed with no payment, and the worker stalled. I reverted the URL to payments-v1, restarted the worker and reprocessed the 23 unpaid orders. All invariants are now green.
